issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the Farm song method: the problem statement (UML and task text) requires a public method named printFarmSong(), but both the provided template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) and the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) define a public method named singFarmSong(). This mismatch between the specification and the code artifacts can confuse students about which method name to implement and which name tests or examples will expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public method name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement (UML and task text) to require singFarmSong() to match the template and solution, or (B) rename the public method in both the template and the solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() (and update any calls/comments). Ensure tests, examples, and the Main class use the same name.
